ios.desc:
Build apps faster with Compot — your library of crafted SwiftUI components with handy code editor and AI assistant featuring over 100 components — ready to copy, tweak, and integrate into your Xcode projects.

Browse library of ready to use SwiftUI components
Explore SwiftUI building blocks, from buttons to paywalls.

Generate SwiftUI code from images or text
Upload a design or describe your UI, and get Swift code instantly.

Get your personal AI coding assistant
Ask questions, debug issues, or get tailored suggestions about your SwiftUI code from an always-available AI assistant designed to keep you moving forward efficiently.

Get AI support for your code
Wondering how to improve or extend code snippets you’ve saved? Use AI assistance anytime for enhancements, explanations, or code extensions that accelerate your workflow.

Copy & paste crafted components and templates – Browse a library of SwiftUI building blocks you can easily copy and paste directly into your app. No package dependencies—just clean vanilla Swift code.

Organize code your way
Use Collections to structure your saved components intuitively.

Discover valuable resources
Stay inspired with curated blogs, newsletters, repositories, and more.
